Welcome to our channel! 🐾

We are an animal rescue organization and shelter based in Ukraine.

Our journey began in 2018 with one animal-loving soul. Today, our mission is to rescue stray animals, provide medical care, and help them find loving forever homes.

🏠 About our shelter:
We care for many rescued animals every day. Some of them are waiting for their families, while others, due to age or health conditions, will stay with us for life and receive lifelong care.

💔 As the war in Ukraine began, many animals were left behind.
We continued rescuing those in need, but soon our facility became too small.

🙏 How you can help ⬇️🇺🇦

Please LIKE, SHARE, and SUBSCRIBE if you want to support our mission and see more rescue stories.

Every bit of support helps us continue our work.

To Support Us and Help more RESCUES:
https://www.paypal.me/LoveFurryFriends
Join us on Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/user?u=69343933
Email:lovefurryfriends1@gmail.com
